nodes.question: What factors contribute to the transition from a centralized energy and chemical production model to a distributed model in PTC technologies?
nodes.answer: Factors contributing to the transition from a centralized to distributed model in PTC technologies include advancements in renewable energy, decentralization of production, technological innovation, and societal demand for sustainability.
